basics.name: Xun (Alex) Sun
basics.summary: Full-stack engineer with 5+ years of experience delivering 20+ projects for Tesla, Nissan, Yanfeng and CLEP, and led a 22-member R&D team. First author of _HERD_, a hybrid continual learning framework for LLMs. Shipped AI products end to end, from GPU cloud infrastructure to medical agents. Active open-source contributor.
basics.label: AI Engineer · Full-stack & Infrastructure

work.name: Monash University
highlights: Built an AI system for 3D-printed footwear, from foot scanning to parametric shoe-last generation.
Automated Blender workflows for upper and sole optimization and nTop workflows for lattice generation.
Delivered AI products for Australian businesses and the open-source community alongside postgraduate study, owning architecture, development and deployment end to end.
Built products spanning elastic GPU infrastructure, AI role-playing, voice customer service and learning tools.

publications.name: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
publications.publisher: Under review at ACL Rolling Review · Xun Sun, Thanh Thi Nguyen, Thuy-Trang Vu
publications.summary: A hybrid continual learning framework that learns in an evolving harness and internalizes that experience into the weights via drift-constrained dual-anchor distillation. On the 25-stage TRACE+17 stream it matches the strongest baseline in new-task acquisition with the least forgetting. [Project page](https://a1exsun.github.io/HERD/)
highlights: First author, solely handling framework design, algorithm implementation, benchmarks, experiments and writing.
